label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect, from esse-cause priority
meaning: The composition route to the first being's pure actuality (firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition) with the cause-to-efficient-cause bridge and efficient-cause priority replaced by one premise on the same cause-of-perfection relation as the q.3 a.7 cause premise: a distinct cause of a thing's esse is simply prior to it. A first being is in act in some respect; if it were in potency in another it would be composite, so it would have a distinct cause of its esse, which is simply prior to it, against firstness. No passage to efficient causing occurs. The route avoids STMT-PERFECTION-CAUSING-IN-ANOTHER-IS-EFFICIENT only because STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND, upstream of the esse-cause priority premise, covers every CausesIn … esse instance: if perfection-causing includes non-efficient exemplar or final causes, that bridge inherits the efficient-cause bridge's failure condition in stronger form. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.

strong_version_needed.3d99779b-b44a-4daa-a873-8ccdd3c034ae: As in firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition: the route takes act in some respect (STMT 8288ff1e), not act in being; the restriction to act in being suffices with STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING, which this route does not assume.
